lore.title: The First Ember
lore.text: Before gyms, before ranks, one trainer lit a fire on a bare hill and asked a stray Charmander to stay. Every league since began at that fire.

lore.title: The Tide Ledger
lore.text: Fishers on the old coast kept a ledger of every catch they let go. The last page reads: 'They remember kindness longer than we do.'

lore.title: The Hollow Bell
lore.text: A bell with no clapper hangs in a ruined tower. It rings only when a trainer who has never lied walks beneath it.

lore.title: The Ninth Badge
lore.text: Old leaders swear there was a ninth badge, given for something other than winning. Nobody remembers what it was for.

lore.title: The Mirror Trainer
lore.text: A traveller who always fights one step ahead of you is only your shadow with better manners. Beat them kindly and they fade.

lore.title: A Letter Before the Storm
lore.text: Found pinned to a gatepost: 'If the sky goes green, take the low road. The high road belongs to the ones who made the storm.'

lore.title: The Salt Road
lore.text: Merchants once crossed the desert on a road paved with salt. Where a caravan fell, a Pokémon of that caravan still guards the stones.

lore.title: The Lantern Oath
lore.text: Campers swear on a lantern: no one is left behind on the trail. It is the oldest rule that nobody ever wrote down.

lore.title: The Gym That Lost
lore.text: One gym closed because its leader lost on purpose, to a child who needed the badge more. The sign still hangs, face down.

lore.title: The Egg Song
lore.text: Breeders hum a tune to unhatched eggs. If the Pokémon inside knows it, it hatches a little early.

lore.title: The Empty Chair
lore.text: The Champion's chair at the summit is never dusted. They say it keeps the shape of everyone who sat there and left.

lore.title: The Rival's Scar
lore.text: Every champion has a rival who gave them a scar they are proud of. The rivals keep the matching one.

lore.title: The Whispering Wood
lore.text: In the wood, trees repeat what trainers say, a season late. Folk go there to hear what they should have said.

lore.title: The Ash Market
lore.text: After a big battle, a market appears at the edge of the field. Everything is cheap. Nothing there was ever really lost.

lore.title: Twin Flames
lore.text: Two trainers once walked into a volcano together and walked out with one team. They never agreed on whose it was.

lore.title: The Last Lullaby
lore.text: A Jigglypuff sang a whole stadium to sleep, then tucked every sleeper in. The match was a draw.

lore.title: The Paper Crane
lore.text: A folded paper crane found on a bench has a route drawn inside it. Following it never leads anywhere dangerous, only somewhere honest.

lore.title: The Deep Register
lore.text: The oldest guestbook lists trainers who passed through a cave and signed with a paw print. There are more paw prints than names.

lore.title: In the Legend's Wake
lore.text: Legendary Pokémon leave weather behind them like a wake behind a boat. Learn to read the sky and you can learn where they went.

lore.title: The Unwritten Ending
lore.text: There is a page at the back of the champion's book that stays blank for everyone. It is for the one who does not need to be remembered.

{name} became {to} and hid behind its trainer for an hour. Then it came out and showed everyone.
{name}'s diary reads: 'Slept. Woke up as {to}. Still hungry.'
{name}'s diary: 'As {to} I can carry the others when they are tired. I mean to do that.'
{name} became {to} and the first thing it did was find its trainer. It did not need a reason.
{name} insists it was always {to}. Nobody argues.
{name}'s diary: 'New {to} legs, new view. The world is taller than I remembered, and more interesting.'
{name} became {to} in the rain. It stayed out a little longer than needed, just listening.

hints.text: An old trainer murmurs: 'A clean sheet is a rarer thing than a gold badge.'
A rival's note: 'Next time, I would rather see you at the finish line than across it.'
The sky is wrong tonight. The one who made it is still waiting at the end of the Grand Region.
A child asks if you ever get tired of winning. You say: only when it is for nobody.

ngVariants.name: The Return
ngVariants.text: Old faces know you now. Shopkeepers nod, rivals loiter longer, and the road remembers your boots.

ngVariants.name: The Long Memory
ngVariants.text: The Champion has started writing your name in the margins before you arrive.

ngVariants.name: The Unwritten Page
ngVariants.text: Everyone is waiting to see what you will do with the blank page.

gossip.spy: Overheard: a masked stranger traded secrets on the road, and left no footprints.

gossip.yours: Overheard: a story about you is going around, and it is improving with every telling.
